title: The Old Man Under the Moon
synopsis: A legend about the old man under the moon, a god of marriage in Chinese mythology.

fullText.simplified:
月下老人

    姻缘历来都是人生大事，对于韦固来说，尤其重要。韦固生活在唐代，是一个父母早亡的孤儿。他特别渴望遇到自己的伴侣，但事实却让他屡屡受挫。
    有一天，一个人给他介绍了一个适龄的结婚对象，是一个小官的女儿。在媒人的牵线搭桥下，两人相约第二天早上在城西的寺庙见一面。韦固一如既往地积极主动，天还没亮就已经到了城西寺庙。这时，月亮还挂在树枝上，只见一位白发老人坐在寺庙门口借着月光看书。他身边放着一个布袋子，袋子里有一些红绳。老人满头白发，皮肤却嫩得像一个孩子，穿着一身红袍。韦固不禁被老人吸引，他看了一眼老人的书，却难以辨认，一个字都看不懂。于是他好奇地跟老人搭讪：“老伯伯，您看的是什么书？我也是下过苦功夫读书的人，怎么您的书我一个字都看不懂呢？”老人微微一笑：“这是掌管天下姻缘的书，你怎么能看懂呢？”韦固一听更好奇了，继续追问道：“您看我今天的姻缘能成吗？”老人翻了几页书，头也没抬地说：“回去吧，你妻子现在才三岁，十四年以后才会嫁给你。我已经用袋子里的红绳系在你们脚上了，不管天涯海角，将来你们都会找到彼此的。现在你又何必浪费时间见别人呢？”韦固一听就急了，十四年太久了，他问：“您能带我见见我妻子吗？”老人同意了。
    天亮以后，老人带着韦固去了菜市场。老人指着一个抱小女孩的盲人说：“她怀里的女娃娃就是你妻子。”老人说完就不见了。
    韦固见那个盲人又丑又穷，一点儿都不想娶这个小女孩。他让自己的奴仆悄悄地去杀了这个小女孩。
    很快，十四年过去了。韦固的事业一帆风顺，他在离家百里之外的地方做了官，很受上司的认可和器重。可他的姻缘还是没来，仍然娶不到妻子。做官不久，他的上司王泰找到他，想把自己的女儿嫁给他。这次，韦固终于结婚了。
    婚后，两个人的感情好极了。只是他的妻子总是在眉间贴花，从来不摘下来。一天，韦固问起这件事情。妻子说：“三岁那年，奶娘带我去菜市场。不知道为什么有一个丧心病狂的坏人，突然要来杀我。但很幸运，他只在我的眉间扎了一刀。我没有死，但眉间留了一个疤。现在我在眉间贴花，是为了挡住这个疤。”
    韦固听完，想起十四年前的事情，吃惊地问：“你的奶娘是盲人吗？她只是你的奶娘，不是你的母亲？”妻子也吃惊地说：“你怎么知道我的奶娘是盲人？我很小的时候父母亲就死了，我的奶娘一边在菜市场卖菜一边养着我。后来我的叔叔王泰找到了我，把我带回了家。叔叔对我很好，把我当亲生女儿一样养大，我也把他当父亲。”韦固这才明白，原来当年菜市场里见到的那个小女孩真的成了自己的妻子。他向妻子坦白了自己年轻时犯下的错误。两个人听完不禁感叹，妻子最后也原谅了他。
    韦固十四年后才明白，原来当时寺庙外的老人就是月下老人，是掌管姻缘的神。
fullText.traditional:
月下老人

    姻緣歷來都是人生大事，對於韋固來說，尤其重要。韋固生活在唐代，是一個父母早亡的孤兒。他特別渴望遇到自己的伴侶，但事實卻讓他屢屢受挫。
    有一天，一個人給他介紹了一個適齡的結婚對象，是一個小官的女兒。在媒人的牽線搭橋下，兩人相約第二天早上在城西的寺廟見一面。韋固一如既往地積極主動，天還沒亮就已經到了城西寺廟。這時，月亮還掛在樹枝上，只見一位白髮老人坐在寺廟門口借著月光看書。他身邊放著一個布袋子，袋子裡有一些紅繩。老人滿頭白髮，皮膚卻嫩得像一個孩子，穿著一身紅袍。韋固不禁被老人吸引，他看了一眼老人的書，卻難以辨認，一個字都看不懂。於是他好奇地跟老人搭訕：“老伯伯，您看的是什麼書？我也是下過苦功夫讀書的人，怎麼您的書我一個字都看不懂呢？”老人微微一笑：“這是掌管天下姻緣的書，你怎麼能看懂呢？”韋固一聽更好奇了，繼續追問道：“您看我今天的姻緣能成嗎？”老人翻了幾頁書，頭也沒抬地說：“回去吧，你妻子現在才三歲，十四年以後才會嫁給你。我已經用袋子裡的紅繩繫在你們腳上了，不管天涯海角，將來你們都會找到彼此的。現在你又何必浪費時間見別人呢？”韋固一聽就急了，十四年太久了，他問：“您能帶我見見我妻子嗎？”老人同意了。
    天亮以後，老人帶著韋固去了菜市場。老人指著一個抱小女孩的盲人說：“她懷裡的女娃娃就是你妻子。”老人說完就不見了。
    韋固見那個盲人又醜又窮，一點兒都不想娶這個小女孩。他讓自己的奴僕悄悄地去殺了這個小女孩。
    很快，十四年過去了。韋固的事業一帆風順，他在離家百里之外的地方做了官，很受上司的認可和器重。可他的姻緣還是沒來，仍然娶不到妻子。做官不久，他的上司王泰找到他，想把自己的女兒嫁給他。這次，韋固終於結婚了。
    婚後，兩個人的感情好極了。只是他的妻子總是在眉間貼花，從來不摘下來。一天，韋固問起這件事情。妻子說：“三歲那年，奶娘帶我去菜市場。不知道為什麼有一個喪心病狂的壞人，突然要來殺我。但很幸運，他只在我的眉間扎了一刀。我沒有死，但眉間留了一個疤。現在我在眉間貼花，是為了擋住這個疤。”
    韋固聽完，想起十四年前的事情，吃驚地問：“你的奶娘是盲人嗎？她只是你的奶娘，不是你的母親？”妻子也吃驚地說：“你怎麼知道我的奶娘是盲人？我很小的時候父母親就死了，我的奶娘一邊在菜市場賣菜一邊養著我。後來我的叔叔王泰找到了我，把我帶回了家。叔叔對我很好，把我當親生女兒一樣養大，我也把他當父親。”韋固這才明白，原來當年菜市場裡見到的那個小女孩真的成了自己的妻子。他向妻子坦白了自己年輕時犯下的錯誤。兩個人聽完不禁感嘆，妻子最後也原諒了他。
    韋固十四年後才明白，原來當時寺廟外的老人就是月下老人，是掌管姻緣的神。

sentences.english: Fourteen years quickly passed. Wei Gu’s career went very smoothly.

sentences.simplified: 可他的姻缘还是没来，仍然娶不到妻子。
sentences.traditional: 可他的姻緣還是沒來，仍然娶不到妻子。
sentences.pinyin: kě tā de yīn yuán hái shi méi lái réng rán qǔ bú dào qī zi
sentences.english: He became an official in a place a hundred miles away from his home and was recognized and valued by his superiors.

sentences.simplified: 做官不久，他的上司王泰找到他，想把自己的女儿嫁给他。
sentences.traditional: 做官不久，他的上司王泰找到他，想把自己的女兒嫁給他。
sentences.pinyin: zuò guān bù jiǔ tā de shàng si wáng tài zhǎo dào tā xiǎng bǎ zì jǐ de nǚ ér jià gěi tā
sentences.english: But his destined marriage had still not arrived, and he still couldn’t get a wife.

sentences.simplified: 这次，韦固终于结婚了。
sentences.traditional: 這次，韋固終於結婚了。
sentences.pinyin: zhè cì wéi gù zhōng yú jié hūn le
sentences.english: Not long after he had become an official, his superior Wang Tai approached him, wanting to marry his daughter to him.
This time, Wei Gu finally got married.

sentences.simplified: 婚后，两个人的感情好极了。
sentences.traditional: 婚後，兩個人的感情好極了。
sentences.pinyin: hūn hòu liǎng ge rén de gǎn qíng hǎo jí le

sentences.simplified: 只是他的妻子总是在眉间贴花，从来不摘下来。
sentences.traditional: 只是他的妻子總是在眉間貼花，從來不摘下來。
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ shì tā de qī zi zǒng shì zài méi jiān tiē huā cóng lái bù zhāi xià lái
sentences.english: After marriage, the two had great affection for each other.

sentences.simplified: 一天，韦固问起这件事情。妻子说：“三岁那年，奶娘带我去菜市场。
sentences.traditional: 一天，韋固問起這件事情。妻子說：“三歲那年，奶娘帶我去菜市場。
sentences.pinyin: yì tiān wéi gù wèn qǐ zhè jiàn shì qing qī zi shuō sān suì nà nián nǎi niáng dài wǒ qù cài shì chǎng
sentences.english: However, his wife always stuck flower petals between her eyebrows and never took them off.

sentences.simplified: 不知道为什么有一个丧心病狂的坏人，突然要来杀我。
sentences.traditional: 不知道為什麼有一個喪心病狂的壞人，突然要來殺我。
sentences.pinyin: bù zhī dào wèi shén me yǒu yí ge sàng xīn bìng kuáng de huài rén tū rán yào lái shā wǒ
sentences.english: One day, Wei Gu asked about this. His wife said, “When I was three, my nanny took me to the wet market.

sentences.simplified: 但很幸运，他只在我的眉间扎了一刀。我没有死，但眉间留了一个疤。
sentences.traditional: 但很幸運，他只在我的眉間扎了一刀。我沒有死，但眉間留了一個疤。
sentences.pinyin: dàn hěn xìng yùn tā zhǐ zài wǒ de méi jiān zhā le yì dāo wǒ méi yǒu sǐ dàn méi jiān liú le yí ge bā
sentences.english: I don’t know why, but there was a deranged bad guy who all of a sudden wanted to kill me.

sentences.simplified: 现在我在眉间贴花，是为了挡住这个疤。”
sentences.traditional: 現在我在眉間貼花，是為了擋住這個疤。”
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài wǒ zài méi jiān tiē huā shì wèi le dǎng zhù zhè ge bā
sentences.english: But luckily, he only stabbed me once between the eyebrows. I didn’t die, but a scar was left between my eyebrows.
Now, I stick flower petals between my eyebrows because I want to hide this scar.”

sentences.simplified: 韦固听完，想起十四年前的事情，
sentences.traditional: 韋固聽完，想起十四年前的事情，
sentences.pinyin: wéi gù tīng wán xiǎng qǐ shí sì nián qián de shì qing

sentences.simplified: 吃惊地问：“你的奶娘是盲人吗？她只是你的奶娘，不是你的母亲？”
sentences.traditional: 吃驚地問：“你的奶娘是盲人嗎？她只是你的奶娘，不是你的母親？”
sentences.pinyin: chī jīng de wèn nǐ de nǎi niáng shì máng rén ma tā zhǐ shì nǐ de nǎi niáng bú shì nǐ de mǔ qīn
sentences.english: After hearing this, Wei Gu remembered what had happened fourteen years previously.

sentences.simplified: 妻子也吃惊地说：“你怎么知道我的奶娘是盲人？
sentences.traditional: 妻子也吃驚地說：“你怎麼知道我的奶娘是盲人？
sentences.pinyin: qī zi yě chī jīng de shuō nǐ zěn me zhī dào wǒ de nǎi niáng shì máng rén
sentences.english: He asked, taken aback, “Was your nanny blind? She was just your nanny and not your mother?”

sentences.simplified: 我很小的时候父母亲就死了，我的奶娘一边在菜市场卖菜一边养着我。
sentences.traditional: 我很小的時候父母親就死了，我的奶娘一邊在菜市場賣菜一邊養著我。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ hěn xiǎo de shí hou fù mǔ qīn jiù sǐ le wǒ de nǎi niáng yì biān zài cài shì chǎng mài cài yì biān yǎng zhe wǒ
sentences.english: The wife was also taken aback and said, “How do you know that my nanny was blind?

sentences.simplified: 后来我的叔叔王泰找到了我，把我带回了家。
sentences.traditional: 後來我的叔叔王泰找到了我，把我帶回了家。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái wǒ de shū shu wáng tài zhǎo dào le wǒ bǎ wǒ dài huí le jiā
sentences.english: My parents died when I was very young, and my nanny raised me while selling vegetables at the market.

sentences.simplified: 叔叔对我很好，把我当亲生女儿一样养大，我也把他当父亲。”
sentences.traditional: 叔叔對我很好，把我當親生女兒一樣養大，我也把他當父親。”
sentences.pinyin: shū shu duì wǒ hěn hǎo bǎ wǒ dāng qīn shēng nǚ ér yí yàng yǎng dà wǒ yě bǎ tā dāng fù qīn
sentences.english: Later, my uncle Wang Tai found me and took me home.

sentences.simplified: 韦固这才明白，
sentences.traditional: 韋固這才明白，
sentences.pinyin: wéi gù zhè cái míng bai
sentences.english: My uncle was very kind to me and raised me like his own daughter. I also treated him like my own father.”

sentences.simplified: 原来当年菜市场里见到的那个小女孩真的成了自己的妻子。
sentences.traditional: 原來當年菜市場裡見到的那個小女孩真的成了自己的妻子。
sentences.pinyin: yuán lái dāng nián cài shì chǎng lǐ jiàn dào de nà ge xiǎo nǚ hái zhēn de chéng le zì jǐ de qī zi
sentences.english: Only then did Wei Gu understand.

sentences.simplified: 他向妻子坦白了自己年轻时犯下的错误。
sentences.traditional: 他向妻子坦白了自己年輕時犯下的錯誤。
sentences.pinyin: tā xiàng qī zi tǎn bái le zì jǐ nián qīng shí fàn xià de cuò wù
sentences.english: It turned out that the little girl he saw at the wet market back then had really become his wife.

sentences.simplified: 两个人听完不禁感叹，妻子最后也原谅了他。
sentences.traditional: 兩個人聽完不禁感嘆，妻子最後也原諒了他。
sentences.pinyin: liǎng ge rén tīng wán bù jīn gǎn tàn qī zi zuì hòu yě yuán liàng le tā
sentences.english: He confessed to his wife the mistake he had made when he was young.
After hearing this, the two of them couldn’t help but sigh. In the end, his wife also forgave him.

sentences.simplified: 韦固十四年后才明白，
sentences.traditional: 韋固十四年後才明白，
sentences.pinyin: wéi gù shí sì nián hòu cái míng bai

sentences.simplified: 原来当时寺庙外的老人就是月下老人，是掌管姻缘的神。
sentences.traditional: 原來當時寺廟外的老人就是月下老人，是掌管姻緣的神。
sentences.pinyin: yuán lái dāng shí sì miào wài de lǎo rén jiù shì yuè xià lǎo rén shì zhǎng guǎn yīn yuán de shén
sentences.english: Only after fourteen years did Wei Gu understand.

sentence_translations: The Old Man Under the Moon
Marriage has always been a major life event, and for Wei Gu, it was especially important.
Wei Gu lived during the Tang Dynasty. He was an orphan whose parents died early.
He particularly yearned to find a partner, but reality continually thwarted him.
One day, someone introduced a marriage prospect of suitable age to him. She was the daughter of a minor official.
With the arrangement of a matchmaker, the two of them planned to meet the next morning at a temple in the west of the city.
Wei Gu was enthusiastic and proactive, as always. He arrived at the temple in the west of the city before dawn.
At this time, the moon was still hanging from the tree branches.
He could only see a gray-haired old man sitting at the door of the temple, reading a book by the moonlight.
Next to him was a cloth bag, and in the cloth bag, there was some red string.
The old man had a head full of gray hair, yet his skin was soft like a child’s. He wore a red robe.
Wei Gu couldn’t help but be fascinated by the old man.
He took a glance at the old man’s book, but it was difficult to identify, and he couldn’t understand a single word.
So he curiously struck up a conversation with the old man out of curiosity: “Old man, what book are you reading?”
I am also someone who has put hard work into my studying. How come I can’t understand a single word of your book?”
The old man smiled softly: “This is the book that controls all marriage destiny in this world. How could you understand it?”
After hearing this, Wei Gu was even more curious.
He continued asking, “Can you see whether my marriage destiny today will be successful?”
The old man flipped through a few pages of the book, and without lifting his head, he said, ..
“Go back, your wife is only three years old now. She will not marry you until fourteen years later.”
I have already tied the red string in the bag to your feet.
Even if you are at opposite ends of the world, you will find each other in the future.
So why bother wasting time meeting other people?”
After hearing this, Wei Gu became anxious. Fourteen years was too long. He asked, “Can you take me to see my wife?”
The old man agreed.
After the sun rose, the old man took Wei Gu to the wet market.
The old man pointed to a blind person holding a little girl and said, “The girl in her arms is your wife.”
After the old man finished speaking, he disappeared.
Wei Gu saw that the blind person was both ugly and poor, and did not want to marry this little girl at all.
He ordered his servant to quietly kill the little girl.
Fourteen years quickly passed. Wei Gu’s career went very smoothly.
He became an official in a place a hundred miles away from his home and was recognized and valued by his superiors.
But his destined marriage had still not arrived, and he still couldn’t get a wife.
Not long after he had become an official, his superior Wang Tai approached him, wanting to marry his daughter to him.
This time, Wei Gu finally got married.
After marriage, the two had great affection for each other.
However, his wife always stuck flower petals between her eyebrows and never took them off.
One day, Wei Gu asked about this. His wife said, “When I was three, my nanny took me to the wet market.
I don’t know why, but there was a deranged bad guy who all of a sudden wanted to kill me.
But luckily, he only stabbed me once between the eyebrows. I didn’t die, but a scar was left between my eyebrows.
Now, I stick flower petals between my eyebrows because I want to hide this scar.”
After hearing this, Wei Gu remembered what had happened fourteen years previously.
He asked, taken aback, “Was your nanny blind? She was just your nanny and not your mother?”
The wife was also taken aback and said, “How do you know that my nanny was blind?
My parents died when I was very young, and my nanny raised me while selling vegetables at the market.
Later, my uncle Wang Tai found me and took me home.
My uncle was very kind to me and raised me like his own daughter. I also treated him like my own father.”
Only then did Wei Gu understand.
It turned out that the little girl he saw at the wet market back then had really become his wife.
He confessed to his wife the mistake he had made when he was young.
After hearing this, the two of them couldn’t help but sigh. In the end, his wife also forgave him.
Only after fourteen years did Wei Gu understand.
It turned out that the old man outside the temple was the old man under the moon, the god in charge of marriage destiny.
